description: This file contains the definition of the HandlerUtil class, a utility class that provides methods for managing and retrieving handler components in the OpenMRS framework. It includes functionality for caching handlers, retrieving handlers supporting specific types, and determining preferred handlers based on annotation order.

classes.name: HandlerUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for managing handlers annotated with @Handler within the OpenMRS framework. It handles caching, retrieving, sorting, and selecting preferred handlers based on order annotations.

classes.name: HandlerUtil.Key
classes.description: A private static inner class used as a composite key for caching handler lists based on handler type and supported class.

methods.name: clearCachedHandlers
methods.description: Clears the cached handlers by resetting the cache map.

methods.name: getHandlersForType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of handler instances that support a specific type, ordered by the annotation's order property.

methods.name: getPreferredHandler
methods.description: Returns the handler with the lowest order value supporting the specified type. Throws exceptions if none or multiple handlers share the lowest order.

methods.name: getOrderOfHandler
methods.description: Returns the order value from the @Handler annotation of the specified handler class.
